title: HausmanHub core manual control envelope v1
description: Optional core-control envelope of one explicit manual action routed through the Hausman core admission (HH-014.b, S-06.a). The envelope carries one explicit request id and the control/binding revisions the client based its decision on. It never replaces the legacy requestId or idempotencyKey of the v1 device-action contract.

requestId.description: Identity of one explicit core manual action. The same id must be reused when a batch participant is replayed as a single request.

expectedControlRevision.description: Control revision the client accepted. The server must reject the action when the current control revision differs; substituting the current revision is not allowed.

expectedBindingRevision.description: Binding revision the client accepted. The server must reject the action when the current binding revision differs.

operationId.description: Core operation identity issued by the server. It is not the legacy requestId.

controlRevision.description: Control revision accepted by the core admission.

bindingRevision.description: Binding revision accepted by the core admission.
